note: First 20 rows of the board this entry writes from the sealed snapshot (as_of 2026-11-14), produced by a real run of main.ts during development.

rows.name: Steakhouse Financial
farm_steps: Use a fresh wallet that holds only the funds you plan to farm Steakhouse Financial with, and keep its seed phrase offline. Cost: under $3 of gas for the first transaction. Time: 5 minutes.
Deposit $150 into a Steakhouse Financial vault on Base and keep the shares. Cost: $150 of capital and about $8 of gas. Time: 15 minutes to set up.
Make one qualifying action each week in Steakhouse Financial, such as a deposit, a borrow, a swap or a vote. Cost: about $2 of gas a week. Time: 10 minutes a week.
Hold the position for at least 30 days so the activity is counted in more than one snapshot. Cost: the $150 stays in the position. Time: 30 days.

Watch Steakhouse Financial's own points or rewards page and its official announcements for a launch or snapshot date, and claim only from a link the protocol itself publishes. Cost: no fee to check, and never pay to claim. Time: 10 minutes a week.
Write the wallet, the dates and every transaction in a farm log, and revoke approvals you no longer use. Cost: nothing but the log and a few cents of gas. Time: 5 minutes a month.
